 CONVENIENCE AND NECESSITY FOR THE BELL COUNTY
     EAST SWITCH TO BIG HILL SUBSTATION 765-KV
    TRANSMISSION LINE PROJECT IN BELL, BURNET,
    CONCHO, CORYELL, LAMPASAS, LLANO, MASON,
   MCCULLOCH, MENARD, MILAM, MILLS, SAN SABA,
SCHLEICHER, TOM GREEN, AND WILLIAMSON COUNTIES




                         SOAH ORDER NO. 21
                    NOTICE OF YOUTUBE STREAMING


      All proceedings in this case will be livestreamed on SOAH’s YouTube
channel: https://www.youtube.com/@TexasSOAH. The proceedings include the
prehearing conference scheduled for June 5, 2026, at 1:00 p.m. and the hearing on
the merits scheduled for June 8-12, 2026, beginning at 9:00 a.m. each day. People
 who are observing but not participating should view the proceedings on YouTube in
lieu of joining the Zoom videoconference.


Signed May 28, 2026



_____________________                           ______________________
Cassandra Quinn                                 Linda Brite
Administrative Law Judge                        Administrative Law Judge


_____________________
Dee Marlo Chico
Administrative Law Judge
